experience.exercise4you.shortDescription: Development and maintenance of a web application for patient management and exercise prescription.
experience.exercise4you.description.part: I developed and maintained a web application designed to facilitate patient management and exercise prescription by physiotherapists.
This project was carried out in collaboration with a PhD student in physiotherapy, who acted as the client and defined the specific needs of the tool within the framework of his doctoral thesis.

Exercise4You follows a client-server architecture, with a frontend developed in Angular and a backend implemented in Spring Boot, using modern technologies to ensure the scalability and security of the system. Key features include user and patient management, dynamic questionnaire creation, personalized report generation in PDF format, and the use of specialized tools such as anthropometric calculators.

The application has been deployed in a production environment using Amazon Web Services (AWS) services, such as EC2, RDS, DocumentDB, and S3, with the help of Docker for containerization and deployment simplification.
experience.exercise4you.description.bull: Development of a web application for patient management and exercise prescription.
Use of security measures such as email verification and JWT for user authentication and authorization, password encryption, protection against CSRF attacks, and separation of sensitive data.
Implementation of tools for data management, such as anthropometric calculators and dynamic questionnaires.
Generation of personalized reports in PDF format for patient evaluation and monitoring.
Deployment of the application in a production environment using AWS services, such as EC2, RDS, DocumentDB, and S3, as well as Route 53 and Certificate Manager for secure traffic management.
Use of Docker for containerization and deployment simplification.
experience.exercise4you.pages.descriptio: The application requires users to register and verify their email before being able to log in. This ensures that only authorized users have access to the application and patient data.

Physiotherapists can manage their patients' information, including personal data, medical history, and exercise prescriptions. This allows them to keep a more effective and personalized follow-up of each patient.

The application includes features such as dynamic questionnaires, personalized report generation in PDF format, and the use of specialized tools like anthropometric calculators or aids for setting goals and making prescriptions. These features allow physiotherapists to tailor their approach to the specific needs of each patient.

The application generates personalized reports in PDF format, which include relevant information about the results of the tests performed, goals, and exercise prescriptions. This facilitates communication with patients and provides them with a tangible document for their follow-up. This is an example of a report generated by the application:

The application follows a client-server architecture, with a frontend developed in Angular and a backend implemented in Spring Boot. This allows for a clear separation between the user interface and server logic, making it easier to maintain and scale the application. Additionally, the application has been deployed in a production environment using Amazon Web Services (AWS) services, such as EC2, RDS, DocumentDB, and S3. This ensures the scalability and availability of the application, as well as the security of the stored data.
